question: Counter-Strike: Esport BERG vs NEXORA (BO3) - ESEA Advanced Europe Playoffs
description:
This market refers to the Counter-Strike Lower bracket round 4 match between Esport BERG and NEXORA in the ESEA Advanced Europe Playoffs, initially scheduled for September 14, 2026 at 1:30 PM ET.

This market will resolve to "Esport BERG" if Esport BERG win the match against NEXORA.

This market will resolve to "NEXORA" if NEXORA win the match against Esport BERG.

If the match is canceled (not played at all) or ends in a tie, this market will resolve to 50-50.
